comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts and locks a gripper opening stop; PR-892 loads a filled syringe into a pump, seats its flange, advances the driver gently, and in later versions closes the barrel clamp.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires concentric driver-and-wrench torque coordination; PR-892 requires syringe alignment and insertion, flange-slot seating, clamp articulation, and force-limited driver placement without moving the plunger.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires retained angle, hardware retention, repeated cycles, and released clearance; PR-892 requires a seated and clamped syringe, driver flush to the plunger, no plunger displacement, stillness, and a one-second hold.
comparison.reason: Gentle medical-device loading and no-dose contact control do not test continuous stop adjustment, jam-nut reaction counterholding, or post-lock motion retention; the record's versions provide detailed thresholds.
